scope: Research transport and geometry. Product contracts remain separate.

image.width: positive integer, detector input width in pixels
image.height: positive integer, detector input height in pixels

clock.source_time_ms: source time before any adjustment for detector task; finite, strictly increasing within the clip; retain gaps
clock.detector_time_ms: detector API timestamp; optional per frame; never substitute this for source_time_ms

extractor.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker
extractor.runtime_version: exact installed version or null if historical evidence unavailable
extractor.model_sha256: 64 lowercase hex digits of the actual model bytes
extractor.settings: model setup including person count, thresholds and running mode

frame.source_time_ms: source frame time, not reconstructed from frame number
frame.landmarks: null for unavailable pose, otherwise exactly 33 MediaPipe-indexed rows [x,y,z,visibility,presence]; individual missing values are null
frame.why_unavailable: null with pose; otherwise a reason such as no_pose, detector_error, ambiguous_subject, or unknown
frame.xy: normalized detector input image, origin upper left. May lie outside 0–1; never clamp.
frame.z: MediaPipe relative depth, preserved in raw input only
frame.visibility: model estimate of visibility; null if unavailable
frame.presence: model estimate of landmark presence; null if unavailable
frame.sides: anatomical left and right of the filmed person

output.frame: Same index/source_time_ms/why_unavailable; joint array in joint_order, or null for unavailable pose. One unavailable coordinate makes both x_px and y_px null. No gap filling, confidence filtering or left-right switching.
output.metric_envelope: Separate measurement result per segment: schema measurement-metrics/1, source_id, start_ms inclusive, stop_ms exclusive, method_id, metrics. Each metric has value (number or null), unit, valid_count (nonnegative integer), unavailable_reason (null or explainable code). Per-side metrics have anatomical left/right keys. Detector events use source_time_ms.

geometry: Front end decodes to upright image without pixel mirroring before extraction. A mirrored UI preview is presentation only. The AI adapter rejects other geometry because a transformed detector result cannot establish anatomical semantics.

gdi_legacy.foot_note: MediaPipe foot_index approximates BODY25 big_toe slots; visibility occupies the confidence slot. Presence and z are not used.
gdi_legacy.interpolation: Mapping stage preserves missing values. Legacy feature generation applies its existing interpolation, body scale and centering separately to a selected crop. No inference from mapped joint equality about extractor or event accuracy.
